x: Each year Peter Matthews of the National Union of Track Statisticians compiles a list of club rankings, calculating positions by scoring the best performance by a first-claim member of a club at each standard track and field event using the I.A.A.F. scoring tables.
Peter Matthews of the National Union of Track Statisticians calculates that Belgrave's Gerry North is the most consistent cross country runner that Britain has produced since the War.
